I tried the rextons about a year ago and they were too quiet, it did not seem they would be able to amplify enough for my moderate to severe hearing loss. It's possible we stopped tweaking the settings and that they could have worked for that part, however there was one major issue, which the Sennheiser takes care of perfectly.


My old phonaks, and new sennheisers, can link to more than one phone at the same time. I have a cell phone for work and a personal cell, and I receive and make calls on both of those all day. The rextons could only connect with one at a time and that would have caused like at least a 30 second delay and usually longer, for a call to come in, me to answer it and ask them to hold on, then go to the other phone and disconnect from my bluetooth, and then go back to the first one to connect to the Bluetooth so I could hear.

If for any reason that doesn't work out, you at least have gathered good information for the future. And honestly if the first pair of hearing aids you try from costco, or just one, if you don't like it, you can ask them what another option is, they will have another option for you to check out.

To use this your audiologist needs to do the "pairing" the first time. Once it's set up, which only takes them a few minutes, then you can control it. And I think actually I may have been able to do that myself but it's a multistep process and in her office I had a hard time holding the hearing aid buttons down the right way so she did it for me.


Once its set up, the hearing aids "connect" to your cellphone, whether it's IPhone or Android, through Bluetooth. Then you can hear phone calls and play podcasts or listen to anything online, like if you open a website and play a video, or stream something like a radio show that's on a website.


Or if you do a Google search and it reads it out loud to you, although I turn the volume off for searches because I don't like hearing that. If you want to you can also hear driving directions like from Google maps or wake. Sometimes that’s helpful bu
